roughChance._comment: Independent seeded rough-pasture chance on public level 6 onward; implementation frequency, not a user-approved cadence.

roughClumps._comment: Hard cap on broad volumetric grass rosettes; dense cores and low loose fringes replace solid pasture discs.

roughPatches._comment: Maximum dense grass-cluster anchors. These control density only and never create ground polygons.

roughRocks._comment: Maximum seeded physical pasture boulders outside routes, spawns, goals, water and structures; shares the existing 260-obstacle ceiling.
